name: Bhupali
reason: Used as a girl name; also a well-known raga; meaning fine.

name: Chameli
reason: Jasmine; genuinely given as a girl name.

name: Greeshma
reason: Real girl name; IAST lacked final long a for the Devanagari ग्रीष्मा.

name: Gulmohar
reason: common_noun_or_technical_term: Persian-derived name of a tree, not given to children.

name: Heera
reason: Hindi form of diamond, used as a name for boys and girls.

name: Himalay
reason: Himalaya-derived boy name in real use.

name: Jal
reason: common_noun_or_technical_term: Plain word for water, not a Hindu given name (Jal is Parsi); Neer is the usual name form.

name: Kusum
reason: Classic name, female or unisex.

name: Kusumita
reason: Girl name in use; meaning blossomed/in bloom is correct.

name: Manik
reason: IAST had a stray y; correct spoken form is māṇik.

name: Moti
reason: Pearl; genuinely used as a name (e.g. Motilal, Moti).

name: Nalina
reason: Lotus; used as a girl name.

name: Neer
reason: Water; used as a boy name.

name: Nirjhar
reason: Boy name in real use, mainly Bengali/Hindi.

name: Panna
reason: Emerald; used as a name in Hindu families; origin of the word is debated.

name: Parvat
reason: Mountain; used as a boy name, though uncommon.

name: Pravala
reason: Coral; used as a girl name (cf. Pravalika).

name: Pundarik
reason: Sanskrit puṇḍarīka; name of sages and a Vishnu epithet, used as a boy name.

name: Ragini
reason: Established girl name; meaning acceptable.

name: Sevanti
reason: White chrysanthemum; used as a girl name.

name: Sphatik
reason: common_noun_or_technical_term: Word for crystal, not used as a given name.

name: Vaidurya
reason: common_noun_or_technical_term: Name of a gem; not in genuine use as a given name.

name: Vajra
reason: Thunderbolt of Indra; used as a boy name.

name: Vanraj
reason: Real boy name; spoken form is vanrāj, not vanarāj.

name: Varsha
reason: Common girl name.

name: Vriksh
reason: common_noun_or_technical_term: Plain word for tree, not given as a name; IAST also wrong.
